deadline.value: The deadline for admission and Oxford scholarship consideration is 2027-01-27.
deadline.quote: 12:00 midday UK time on Wednesday 27 January 2027

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold or be predicted to achieve a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours in science or mathematics.
entry_route.quote: a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours

supervisor.value: Before applying, applicants should identify an academic supervisor who is willing to supervise and support the project.
supervisor.quote: identify an academic member of staff who is willing to supervise you

funding.value: All eligible applicants who apply by the deadline are automatically considered for Oxford scholarships.
funding.quote: Final application deadline to be considered for Oxford scholarships

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: DPhil in Earth Sciences at the University of Oxford.
